q: Why does a timestamp at the top of a prompt break caching?
options: Caches match from the first token, so any change early invalidates everything after it

q: In the illustrative calculator, why can caching cost more at a 0% hit rate?
options: Every request pays the cache-write premium without ever reading from the cache
explain: Write premiums only pay off with reuse.

q: Why do agents benefit most from prompt caching?
options: Each turn resends the whole history, so most input is a repeated prefix
explain: Append-only histories turn into cache hits.
